title: Movie AI App
desc: An interactive movie discovery platform powered by TMDB API and enhanced with real-time AI chat using OpenRouter and Mistral 7B. Users can browse movies, watch trailers, and ask questions about each film.
shortDesc: Search movies + ask AI about plot, actors, and endings.
desc1: This project helps users explore movies and TV series in a clean, responsive UI. Integrated with OpenRouter's AI API, the app provides contextual, smart answers to user questions about any film.
desc2: The app is built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It connects to TMDB for content and OpenRouter (via mistralai/mistral-7b-instruct:free) for an AI-powered assistant. Users can interact with AI directly from the movie detail page.
featuredDesc: Built for learning and showcasing how modern frontend technologies and AI can work together in a real-world project.

descItems.title: The Story
descItems.desc: This app started as a clone of an open-source movie platform and evolved into a showcase of how AI can enhance user experience. The goal was to help users not just view movie info, but ask questions and get meaningful responses.

descItems.title: Our Approach
descItems.desc: We used TMDB for content, and OpenRouter's free AI model (Mistral 7B) for natural language interaction. A custom MovieChat component allows users to talk to AI right from the movie detail page, giving the project a unique, interactive twist.
